feature_origin_audit.evidence: The extractor accepts only the strict detector-visible record and uses timestamps/rainfall/river-level values from that current 24-observation window. CREDIBILITY.evidence: Synthetic-only scenario labels and perfect synthetic holdout results do not establish general misinformation detection.

DUPLICATE.evidence: Synthetic-only pair construction with incident, scenario-family, parameter-combination, and text overlap controls; no field-pair validation.

EVENT.evidence: Phase 20 held out canonical event identities but reused scenario templates and did not record parameter-family holdout evidence.

IMAGE.evidence: The scratch CNN was developed exclusively on project-rendered synthetic images; no real-photograph generalization evidence exists.

NLP.evidence: Synthetic-only multilingual templates with documented split-level template, location, lexicon, and time holdouts; no field corpus validation.
